name: ITALY
subtitle: Classic Italy & Dolce Vita
description: With a warm and friendly nature, a Dolce Vita lifestyle, and a passion for fine cuisine. Flash Group brings unparalleled hospitality to the Mediterranean.

regions.name: SICILY
regions.desc: Sicily, the beauty of Italy. It is one of the most renowned islands in Europe due to its greenery, its endless beaches and locally grown products; moreover, its history and lots of films and movies have been shot there.

places.name: Palermo
places.desc: The capital city, known for its narrow streets and traditional street markets.

places.name: Olive Oil Farms
places.desc: Sicilian olive oil is renowned as the best made in Italy. Learn how this culinary liquid gold is produced.

places.name: Ortigia
places.desc: An old city built in the Baroque style, and regarded as a UNESCO world heritage site.

regions.name: SARDINIA
regions.desc: Sardinia, famous for its Turquoise waters, is the perfect destination to completely relax by the beach, enjoying their wine and excellent Italian delicacies.

places.name: Porto Cervo
places.desc: A magnificent marina hosting high-end boutiques and mega-yachts. The ultimate VIP destination.

places.name: Costa Smeralda
places.desc: A stretch of land surrounded by turquoise water, famous for its exclusive beaches and upscale hotels.

places.name: Cagliari
places.desc: The capital city of the Island, featuring a rich medieval history and the hilltop Castello.

name: ZANZIBAR & SAFARI
subtitle: Exotic Escapes & Wildlife
description: Africa, the land of the wildlife. Enjoy the best of both worlds with pristine tropical beaches and unforgettable Savanna Safaris.

regions.name: ZANZIBAR
regions.desc: The island itself has the most famous beaches in Africa, where we will organize your private boat Safaris to sand banks located in the middle of the ocean.

places.name: National Park
places.desc: A vast lagoon blessed with a spectacular landscape of striped sand and mangrove trees.

places.name: Stone Town
places.desc: The ancient capital city. A visit is never complete without seeing Freddie Mercury’s home museum.

places.name: Jozani Forest
places.desc: Home to the Red Colobus: a rare species of monkey regarded as the national symbol of Zanzibar.

regions.name: SAFARI
regions.desc: The most famous Safari’s in the world are in the biggest Savannas located in Africa. We organize Safari excursions with a private car and premium accommodations.

places.name: Selous Reserve
places.desc: Africa’s largest protected reserve and home to the largest concentration of elephants. UNESCO site.

places.name: Ngorongoro
places.desc: A safe haven for globally threatened species to thrive in their natural habitat free of poachers.

places.name: Mikumi Park
places.desc: A wild park featuring a variety of wild animals and home to the famous tree-climbing lions.

name: MOROCCO
subtitle: The Gateway to Africa
description: Immerse yourself in vibrant colors, rich traditions, and unparalleled North African luxury across Marrakech, Atlas, and the Sahara.

regions.name: MARRAKECH
regions.desc: Known as the 'Red City', Marrakech is a sensory masterpiece where ancient traditions meet modern luxury from the souks to elite Riads.

places.name: Luxury Riads
places.desc: Experience ultimate privacy and authentic Moroccan hospitality in high-end boutique Riads.

places.name: Jemaa el-Fnaa
places.desc: The vibrant heartbeat of the city and a UNESCO Masterpiece of world cultural heritage.

places.name: Bahia Palace
places.desc: A 19th-century palace reflecting the true essence of Islamic and Moroccan architectural brilliance.
